Singur was the site of Tata Motors' Nano small-car factory, for which the then Left Front government acquired around 997 acres in 2006. The acquisition triggered a prolonged farmers' agitation led by Mamata Banerjee, following which Tata Motors moved the project to Sanand in Gujarat in 2008. In August 2016, the Supreme Court quashed the land acquisition and ordered that the land be returned to the farmers. "The West Bengal Industrial Development Corporation (WBIDC) had been tasked with acquiring the 997 acres, and negotiations with farmers were underway to purchase the land at a reasonable rate," Adhikari told reporters. The net bill was USD 10.0 billion in October 2025. Crude imports alone cost USD 19.5 billion, against USD 10.4 billion a year ago, even though volumes rose only 11 per cent to 23.3 million tonnes. LNG imports cost USD 1.3 billion, and petroleum product exports brought in USD 6.3 billion. Brent averaged USD 116.77 in September and USD 64.75 in October 2025. title: India, Canada conclude sixth round of talks for proposed trade pact

The negotiations covered key areas, including trade in goods, trade in services, rules of origin, trade remedies, intellectual property and investment promotion, the commerce ministry said. Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal held a meeting with Glenn Purves, Vice Minister of International Trade of Canada, and his delegation to review the progress of negotiations for the proposed Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA). The ten-day talks concluded on November 20. "Both sides reaffirmed their shared commitment to concluding an ambitious, balanced and commercially meaningful agreement that delivers tangible benefits to farmers, industries, businesses and Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) in both countries," it said.
